areas.label: Complete active C implementation
areas.evidence: t65C_impl is active C in code_0805FB7C under the normal compiler and flags. The NONMATCHING wrapper and original sub_080636B0.s fallback are removed. The complete normal ROM compares exactly, the full NONMATCHING build passes and check_tree reports 0 errors. The earlier source shape was introduced in 771284ad45a7c41702768712ac8a7c73c2816821.

areas.label: Initialization lifetimes and register allocation
areas.evidence: The former 1236-byte draft had the correct 172-byte frame but GCSE reused the twice-assigned text pseudo HI subreg for h0, adding an early word-zero store at SP+0x98 and a halfword reload. RTL was checked against an unchanged 3540-byte whole-object control (SHA256 50da7b6417a16d8e2cd7a53ca5986cc86f14b48e5dc22a3b9243596e3c0b8e75). A separate initialized s32 heightZero bound to r3, with a marked empty read/write constraint, preserves the original independent zero through its halfword store. The lifetime ends before any call; no opcode or undefined register input is supplied. This removes the unwanted text spill/reload and reproduces all 1232 original bytes and relocations. Ordinary declaration/type/literal-order variants, a metadata aggregate and the bounded permuter did not match. An unconstrained zero, an input-only r3 constraint and a text barrier also failed; the independent initialized r3 lifetime was decisive.

areas.label: Exact active C and linked ROM match
areas.evidence: The real whole-module comparison reports MATCH with identical normalized bytes and relocations. After unwrapping the C, deleting the original ASM fallback and forcing the affected normal object to rebuild, make compare reports shiningsoul2_eu.gba: OK. The linked active C symbol is at 0x080636B0 with size 0x4D0 (1232 bytes); the full NONMATCHING build and tree check pass. Landed code checkpoint 374d7974750bde75e9bd419e54eacacdf26f1bf4 reproduces the complete EU ROM with SHA1 aa1288be9257337abdfe3034898cf6c7aa778fbc. 1232 matching C bytes are recovered.
